rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality, minimally cavitating/early blastocyst with absent-poor ICM and TE consistent with 0DD. Minor overreach includes asserting normal zona thickness and specific debris/polar body details that are not clearly verifiable from the image alone.

Integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, sperm quality, cohort size, and first-cycle status well, and appropriately contrasts favorable patient factors with severely poor embryo morphology.

Overall logic is clear and consistent: very poor morphology drives prognosis despite favorable uterine and general clinical factors. Minor issues include somewhat speculative attribution to lab conditions and protocol effects, and a probability range that is plausible but not tightly evidence-grounded.

Morphology interpretation and cautious counseling are broadly aligned with IVF practice, but recommendations such as GH, DHEA, myo-inositol, sperm DNA fragmentation testing, and suggesting Day 3 transfer are more controversial or not routinely guideline-supported for this profile.

Provides practical counseling for proceeding versus canceling transfer, luteal support, hCG follow-up, and future-cycle considerations. Slightly reduced by inclusion of several speculative adjuncts rather than prioritizing strongest evidence-based next steps.
